posts.caption:
Almost time for Motorcycle Live 2026… 
-
This photo is back from last year on stage when we announced our entry into the new World Sportbike Championship! Looking forward to it all kicking off starting this Saturday! 
-
Are you coming???

Here’s a one of my favourite photos from each round of the 2026 season! 
-
Starting off with 🇵🇹 

🇳🇱 Excited to race at the Cathedral Of Speed? 😂

🇨🇿 Adventured off to the hills of Autodrome Most. An amazing circuit to race at. 

🇪🇸 First taste of Prosecco this year 🤪

🇮🇹 Being told you need to go faster? @leonxjonesss 

🇫🇷 Track walk in Magnycours 

🇮🇹 Best race of my career so far 🤩

🇪🇸 Season Finale in Spain. Was told to pack it in after this…

A few more snaps from my trip to Eicma the other week! Really nice to get off and explore such an amazing show in Italy, meeting up and networking with sponsors is always good with the @phrperformance squad. 
-
Not long now until I’m back on track testing new parts for 2027. Counting down the days!…
